history.note: test corrected in its own phase; reviewed by the inspector and the human

requirement_quote: While no LL function has been called after reset, the RCC LL driver shall not write any RCC register.
summary: SWE4-02: UT-018 incorrectly asserted zero immediately after memset. It now snapshots RCC in preinit and checks the full volatile array first in main, before resets or LL calls. A temporary constructor CR write caused UT-018 FAIL; removing that injected harness fault restored full PASS. Host startup/reset-image limits are documented.
